source.title: Nerub-ar Palace Raid - Loot Drops, Item Levels, Mounts, Rewards
source.author: iMX3

notes: Nerub-ar Palace Chest token. Source guide links each token and class tier reward item. The token synthesizes one eligible class item, not all alternatives. Mage chest is Runecoat of Violet Rebirth (212095), confirmed by its item tooltip; guide's listed Slippers of Violet Rebirth (212094) is feet, not tier chest. Difficulty-specific bonus IDs are not captured.
